notes.title: 🚂 TrainClicker Idle Evolution – Patch 1.1.4 (Major Update!) 🚂
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39798409/05b80b9b9a8406cec8fed991297216239935ea1a.png
🚂 TrainClicker Idle Evolution – Idle Fest Update 🚂

Big changes have arrived! This update brings a major art overhaul, improved level design, better balance, and smoother gameplay for a more relaxing and rewarding experience.
🆕 What’s New?

🎨 Complete Art Overhaul – A fresh, cozy, and vibrant new look! And more to come!
🏗️ Level & Balance Improvements – Smoother progression, fairer boss challenges, and better rewards.
⚡ UI & Performance Upgrades – Cleaner visuals, better flow, and improved performance.
🐛 Bug Fixes & Optimizations – Smoother gameplay, fewer issues.

💬 More improvements are on the way! Thank you for your support – keep the feedback coming!

🚆 Update now and enjoy the ride! 🚆✨

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: Unfortunately the last update introduced a few bugs, our apologies! However, they should all be fixed now. Please let us know if you encounter anything else. Thank you!

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
+Fixed a skin bug where some engine skins are in use even if they are not.
+Fixed Auto Clicker Talent upgrade cost.
+Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2 is now live!
notes.notes:
This patch contains new features and bug fixes based on your feedback. Thanks for playing!!

New Features
Added Auto clicker Talent.
Added a reward system.
Added a way to purchase skins (with in game currency)


Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where Engine skins are sometimes set to used even when none of the engines are using them.
Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
+Fixed a start up game bug that happens rarely that halts game progress.

notes.title: Mini-update
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
+ Fixed a bug where switching engines wasn't possible

UI Changes:
+ Now when talents are upgraded using gems, it will ask to confirm (If it is set to ask for confirmation on the settings menu).

notes.title: Patch - 1.1.126
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where it was showing an incorrect unlocked level on the level progression bar.

notes.title: Patch - Minor changes
notes.notes:
Changes


 Fixed UI bugs

 Skill upgrades will now be notified
 Randomized music on start

notes.title: Patch - Minor fixes.
notes.notes:
Minor Fixes

  Fixed a bug where offline gold was not collected.

notes.title: Patch - June 2021
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39798409/f8b1fad141780dcf09033cfeddec94cee547d399.jpg
This patch contains new features and bug fixes based on your feedback. Thank you for playing!!

New Features

 Added a Talent system to further improve your train and gameplay.
 Added a Skin system to customize your train as you progress in the game.

Miscellaneous

 Balanced how the levels are progressed. 
 Added a talent to auto select levels. 
 Added a talent to switch train cars.
 Added indicators to confirm when engines and engineers have been upgraded.

Music

 Added two new music tracks.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where Fred’s Time rift skill was unable to be selected for use. 
 Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.100 is now live!
notes.notes:
Fixed the white background bug - Many thanks to those who have assisted us with resolving this issue! 
 Now the Day night cycle persists through levels.
 Adjusted terrain lighting.
 Changed the night time ambience sound. 
 Fixed minor bugs.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Removed the gold cap. Gold can now reach up to trillions and more!
 Added more sound controls.
 Added brightness controls.
 Added/modified sounds - victory/defeat sounds, daytime ambience sound changed. 
 Lighting adjusted.

 Bug fixes 
     
Effect of gold steam skill is more clear now. 
Fixed a bug where restricted skills can still be activated during boss levels.
Fixed a bug where effects of restricted skills can go into boss levels. 
Background changed to fix the white background bug - Anyone who is having the white background bug, please let us know if this is fixed. (It is a bit difficult to come up with an exact fix without having access to an affected machine) Thanks!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.notes:
+ Now the skills can be activated with keys (1-3).
 +  Increased the coin pool.
 +  Working on background textures to potentially fix white background issue.
 + "Go" sound volume reduced.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.notes:
+ Potential fix for white background. 
   
 A few users were having an issue where the background was just plain white. We changed the shaders as a potential fix for this issue. 


+Fixed Day night cycle bug
   
 Fixed an issue where sun was coming up during night.
 Fixed a bug where selecting levels cause the rooster sound to play multiple times.
 Fixed a lighting issue where level seams were showing.

notes.title: Sound balance patch 1.0.7
notes.notes: Hello everyone! We have balanced the sounds to make the train sound more audible. There will be detailed sounds options to control individual sound categories soon! Thanks!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This update fixes most of the critical bugs users mentioned, and also added a feature to reset everything. 

+Fixed critical bugs 

 Fixed a bug where engineer xp became negative.
 Fixed a bug where replacing skills retained its ability. 


+Added a feature to hard reset the game data.

 Settings -> Reset Game, and can select to reset everything including/excluding gold or gems.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

This minor patch fixes the critical bug where the player gold end up being negative. Thanks for your patience!
